The function description says "The 3 letter code of the departing airport". But the user gave city names. We might need to find the nearest airport to Rivermist. There\'s a function get_nearest_airport_by_city. That returns the nearest airport. Then we can use that airport code for get_flight_cost. So we need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city with location: "Rivermist". Then get the nearest airport code. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from: nearest airport code, travel_to: "Los Angeles" but we need the IATA code for Los Angeles. The function expects 3-letter code. We might need to get the nearest airport for Los Angeles too. There\'s get_nearest_airport_by_city for Los Angeles. So we call get_nearest_airport_by_city with location: "Los Angeles". Then we get the nearest airport code. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from: nearest airport code for Rivermist, travel_to: nearest airport code for Los Angeles, travel_date: "2024-12-15", travel_class: "business". Then we can output the cost.\n\nWe need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city twice. Let\'s do that.')
